title: Maharaja
desc: Rajashekhar has two sons, Surya and Kiran, but Surya is adopted. Surya is very hardworking and makes many sacrifices for the family, thereby inciting jealousy in his brother Kiran's heart.

title: Namma Preethiya Ramu
desc: Ramu, a singer with visual impairment, tries to earn a living for his family through his meagre income. However, his life changes when an evil man with hidden motives promises him his eyesight.

title: Odahuttidavaru
desc: Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.

title: Benki
desc: When antisocial elements in a humble village community harass a young woman, her protective brother embarks on a path of vengeance.

title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
